t: You're at the Guards' Chapel at Wellington Barracks in Westminster. It is the Royal Military Chapel, the religious home of the Household Division. The first chapel here was completed in 1838 in the style of a Greek temple, and it was redesigned in the 1870s. It was damaged by German bombing during the Blitz in 1940 and 1941. One of those who died here in the V1 bombing of the chapel was George Kemp-Welch, a cricketer who played first-class cricket for Warwickshire, Cambridge University and the MCC between 1927 and 1936.
